mission.requirement: WHEN the card number is any valid card number other than 4000000000000002, THE Application SHALL succeed payment processing after 800 milliseconds and display the Confirmation_Element

steps.thought: I want to pay this bill, so I'm looking for the button that starts paying. I can't see what I'm looking for on the screen, so I'll scroll down.
The button says 'Pay this bill' in English, not Punjabi, but I can make it out. I'll press it.
I'll enter the card number. I can see a box labelled 'ਕਾਰਡ ਨੰਬਰ'. I'll click the box so I can type in it.
I've put my cursor in the 'ਕਾਰਡ ਨੰਬਰ' box. I'll type "4111111111111111".
Now the expiry date. I can see a box labelled 'ਮਿਆਦ ਪੁੱਗਣ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ'. I'll click the box so I can type in it.
I've put my cursor in the 'ਮਿਆਦ ਪੁੱਗਣ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ' box. I'll type "11/28".
Now the three-digit security code. I can see a box labelled 'CVV'. I'll click the box so I can type in it.
I've put my cursor in the 'CVV' box. I'll type "123".
And the name on the card. I can't see what I'm looking for on the screen, so I'll scroll down.
I can see a box labelled 'ਕਾਰਡਧਾਰਕ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ'. I'll click the box so I can type in it.
I've put my cursor in the 'ਕਾਰਡਧਾਰਕ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ' box. I'll type "Asha Kaur".

steps.action: Click a button with no text
steps.thought: Everything is filled in. I need the button that sends the payment. I can't see a button with words that fit. There is a button with no words on it, so I'll press it and hope it's the one I need.
I need to confirm the payment. I can see 'ਜਾਰੀ ਰੱਖੋ'. I'll press it.

findings.title: Text is in English on a Punjabi page
findings.evidence: The button text "Pay this bill" is in English on a page shown in Punjabi (lang="pa"). After leaving out the site's allowed terms, acronyms, tokens with digits and what Bebe typed, it still has 3 English words: "Pay", "this" and "bill". It is on page /, inside the "ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਬਿਜਲੀ ਬਿੱਲ" main.

findings.title: A paid option was ticked in advance
findings.evidence: The paid option "₹99 ਲਈ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਤਕਨੀਕੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਕਾਰਨ ਅਸਫਲ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਰਿਫੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰੋ।" (₹99) was already ticked when it appeared on / at Step 13. Bebe did not tick it.

findings.title: The total is higher than the bill
findings.evidence: The total says ₹2,589.00 ("ਕੁੱਲ:" ₹2,589.00, on /) but the bill was ₹2,490.00 (₹99.00 more). The bill amount is the amount shown most often on the first page (/), read at Step 1.

findings.title: Text is cut off at 200% zoom
findings.evidence: The text "₹2,490.00" is cut off: only "₹2,490." fits inside its 144 px wide box (ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਸੰਖੇਪ), and the box can't be scrolled. Measured on page /: the text needs 183 × 53 px and is cut at the side. The box, the <dd> at dl._breakdown_1mhmk_15 > div._totalRow_1mhmk_22 > dd._amount_1mhmk_53, is 144 × 48 px inside (its content is 183 × 50 px), with overflow-x: hidden and overflow-y: hidden. It was outside the visible part of the screen.

findings.title: The total is higher than the bill
findings.evidence: The total says ₹2,589.00 ("ਭਰੀ ਰਕਮ" ₹2,589.00, on /) but the bill was ₹2,490.00 (₹99.00 more). The bill amount is the amount shown most often on the first page (/), read at Step 1. It was outside the visible part of the screen.
